daily.title: MOZI Daily
daily.note: Today's macro volatility depends entirely on the US CPI data released at 13:30 EST (early morning Beijing time). Before the data release, the market is in a 'data vacuum' period, and volatility may narrow. Investors are advised to focus on stock logic, that is, whether the current market pricing for 'inflation stickiness' and 'economic resilience' is sufficient, and prepare for directional breakthroughs that the data may trigger.

aboutMozi.intro: Mozi is a professional crypto data analysis platform dedicated to providing global users with accurate, real-time cryptocurrency market data and analysis services. We simplify trading, lower barriers, help users make informed investment decisions, reduce risks, and achieve higher returns.
aboutMozi.description: As a professional crypto data analysis platform, Mozi solves users' pain points of where to buy, what to buy, and how to buy by integrating multiple data sources, providing comprehensive search and rich rankings for users to explore, including but not limited to exchange rankings, popular coin rankings, and price change rankings, currently covering data from mainstream exchanges. To ensure data accuracy and timeliness, the Mozi team consists of experienced professionals covering trading, data development, data analysis, AI, and platform architecture. Their expertise provides strong support for platform data accuracy and reliability. As a startup, Mozi upholds the philosophy of Mozi's universal love and non-aggression, committed to spreading this philosophy globally. We also sincerely invite interested technical, operational, product teams and investment institutions to contact us.
aboutMozi.visionText: Make Trading Simpler, Smarter, and Safer
